To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

influenza A/H3 viruses circulating in Uganda during the two seasons studied were similar to those circulating in other regions of southern Africa and that the viruses were antigenically different from those recommended for inclusion in the vaccine in the 2009 and 2010 northern hemisphere seasons.

the viruses circulating in Uganda during the seasons 2008 and early 2009 differed in their evolutionary relationships from each other, and that they were more closely related to the recommended vaccine strain for the 2009 to 2010 Northern hemisphere season (A/Brisbaine/10/2007) than to the 2010 to 2011 vaccine strain (A/perth/16/2009).
